answer: Identity is sealed to a hardware boot measurement; its transistor drift, a slow umber hum no two chips share, must be echoed in a timing challenge on real silicon within the latency its location allows, and a rented swarm of clones answers identically, refused outright. Reputation accretes like pearl on each verified node while tundra-hardened relays anchor the timing floor, so counterfeiting one agent costs a whole machine, not a config line.
